title: Health Plan Change Windows by Eligibility Category
content:
A Medicaid Managed Care Membership member may change to another health plan in three kinds of window. The figures below are the same in every eligibility category.

## Change windows by eligibility category

| Category | Change without cause after the enrollment date (calendar days) | Annual open enrollment window (calendar days) | Change with a documented cause at any time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | 90 | 60 | Allowed |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | 90 | 60 | Allowed |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | 90 | 60 | Allowed |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | 90 | 60 | Allowed |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 90 | 60 | Allowed |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | 90 | 60 | Allowed |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | 90 | 60 | Allowed |

## Meaning of each window

- **Without cause after enrollment.** The calendar days after the enrollment date during which the member may change health plans without giving a cause: 90.
- **Annual open enrollment.** A window 60 calendar days long that opens the category's renewal packet lead days before the renewal due date.
- **With a documented cause.** In every category a documented cause allows a plan change at any time.

## Hypothetical reading

*A hypothetical member of Prairie Ridge Family Care, whose renewal packet lead is 60 days, with a renewal due date of 30 June*: the open enrollment window opens on 1 May and runs for 60 days.
